name: Underlying Transaction 35
definition: Identifies the underlying (group of) transaction(s) to which the resolution of investigation applies.

OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus.name: Original Group Information And Status
OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus.definition: Provides information on the original cancellation message, to which the resolution refers.

OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus.name: Original Payment Information And Status
OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus.definition: Provides information on the original (group of) transactions, to which the cancellation status refers.

TransactionInformationAndStatus.name: Transaction Information And Status
TransactionInformationAndStatus.definition: Provides details on the original transactions to which the cancellation request message refers.

GroupOrPaymentInformationResolvedCaseRul.definition: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

GroupOrInitiationTransactionResolvedCase.definition: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

GroupOrInterbankTransactionResolvedCaseR.definition: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.
